serp.note: Official. Free 100 tasks/mo (2-step Zaps only). Professional annual tiers: 750 $19.99, 1,500 $39, 2,000 $49, 5,000 $89 (varies by source), 10,000 $129, 100,000 $489. Monthly ≈ 50% more (33% annual discount). Team annual: 2,000 $69, 10,000 $169, 100,000 $599. Overage 2.5× monthly / 1.25× annual up to 3× ceiling.

Full 2026 tier ladder: Pro annual 750/2k/10k/100k = $19.99/$49/$129/$489; Team annual 2k/10k/100k = $69/$169/$599. Confirms 2.5× monthly / 1.25× annual overage + 3× hard ceiling. Free plan is two-step only.

What counts as a task — successful action = 1 task. Formula: monthly trigger events × average actions per workflow ≈ monthly tasks. Three scenarios: lead form, e-commerce orders, agency intake. Core insight: 'real cost is tied to workflow design, not just number of leads or orders.'

Calculator methodology: Monthly tasks = triggers × steps per workflow. Compares Zapier vs Make vs Pabbly (Pabbly 30-50% lower because it excludes triggers and filters). Shows per-tier cost deltas at 2k and 10k task volumes; small/medium/large team guidance.

Confirms Free 100 / Pro $19.99 / Team $69 / Enterprise custom. Free step list: trigger, Filter, Paths, Formatter, Delay, Looping, Digest, Storage, Zapier Manager, Tables, Forms — all 0 tasks. MCP = 2 tasks per call. Lead Router = 5 tasks per routed lead. Overage 1.25× capped at 3×. Sample Pro annual costs: 750 $19.99, 5k ~$130, 10k ~$300, 15k $600+ (higher than official/lindy — source disagreement flagged in post).

Full tier table w/ annual billing 33% savings. 'A 5-step Zap running 150 times uses 750 tasks — your entire Pro base tier in a single workflow.' Example: 4-task-per-run form automation at 200 submissions = 800 tasks exhausts 750 base. Flags 3× pause ceiling: Pro 750 stops at 2,250.

Clear Zaps-vs-tasks framing: 'A Zap can be working exactly as designed while using far more tasks than its owner expected.' Concrete branching math example: 200 runs × (0.6 × 2 actions + 0.4 × 4 actions) = 560 tasks. Lists free steps: trigger, Filter, Paths, Formatter, Delay, Looping, Digest, Storage, filter-blocked steps, failed/halted actions.

2026 tier overview + AI integration note: 'AI steps, Code by Zapier, Zapier MCP, and the Zapier SDK now all draw from the same shared task pool.' Free restricted to two-step Zaps. Flags how multi-step workflows accelerate task depletion.

Official definition: 'A task is any successful action that runs in Zapier. Only successful actions count toward your task usage.' Confirms triggers/polling never bill, Filter/Paths/Formatter/Delay/Looping/Digest/Manager/Tables/Forms all free. MCP = 2 tasks, Lead Router = 5 tasks. Next Gen Zaps (Dec 1, 2026) still bill at least 1 task per successful run using same rates as Classic.

Official pay-per-task explainer: 'Zap workflows will stop running if your account reaches the maximum pay-per-task usage amount. This is set at 3 times your plan's task limit.' Pro 750 → 2,250 ceiling. When pay-per-task is on, Zaps continue at per-task rate; off = Zaps pause at tier limit.

factcheck.claim: Zapier Free is 100 tasks/month, two-step Zaps only, 15-minute polling. Professional annual list starts at $19.99/mo for 750 tasks ($29.99 monthly). Team annual starts at $69/mo for 2,000 tasks and 25 users ($103.50 monthly).

A task is any successful action in Zapier. Triggers (including polling), Filter, Paths, Formatter, Delay, Looping, Digest, Storage, Zapier Manager, Zapier Tables, and Zapier Forms all cost zero tasks. Failed or halted actions do not bill.

Pay-per-task overage rate is 1.25× the normal per-task rate on annual plans and 2.5× on monthly plans, up to a hard ceiling of 3× the plan's task limit — Professional 750 stops at 2,250 completed tasks, Team 2,000 stops at 6,000.
A branching Zap with Paths costs weighted-average tasks: 200 runs with a 60/40 split (branch A = 2 actions, branch B = 4 actions) bills (200 × 0.6 × 2) + (200 × 0.4 × 4) = 560 tasks, not 800.

Zapier MCP tool calls bill 2 tasks per successful call and Zapier Lead Router bills 5 tasks per successful lead routed — both pull from the same shared task pool as AI by Zapier and Code by Zapier steps.

demand.evidence: Nine of ten top results explicitly target 'Zapier pricing 2026' + 'how many tasks' phrasing with 2026 freshness. Sibling tails 'zapier task limits', 'zapier pricing calculator', and 'how many zapier tasks do I need' all surface active 2026-dated content with multiple pricing-calculator pages, confirming sustained search demand.

intent.evidence: Entire top 10 is informational pricing-explainer and sizing-guide blog posts with tier tables and cost breakdowns — no video-only results, no transactional product-purchase pages dominating. A long-form sizing walkthrough is exactly what this SERP rewards.
